visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit indoor space with a woman with auburn hair in a white 'MORE THAN' t-shirt interacting with a man wearing glasses and large headphones. Behind them is a large purple amethyst geode on a black stand. The man's face is distorted by a social media filter, giving him an oversized mouth and bulging eyes while he talks and makes various facial expressions. (2) The scene shifts to a living room with a grey couch and white walls adorned with children's colorful artwork. The woman and man perform a physical flexibility competition. She easily touches her fingertips together behind her back and bends her fingers into heart shapes, while the man attempts to replicate the movements with exaggerated effort and humor, visibly failing to reach her level of bendiness in the wide-open room. (3) The scene cuts to an outdoor patio with a wicker table where three white KiGO sunglass cases are displayed against a background of lush green palms. A young boy wearing a superhero t-shirt walks confidently through the garden wearing black-framed sunglasses. The camera captures close-ups of him posing and touching the glasses, followed by an indoor shot where a hand presents white-framed glasses to the man sitting on a couch. (4) In a bright outdoor area near a pool with a colorful inflatable unicorn, hands demonstrate the extreme flexibility of the sunglass frames by twisting and pulling the plastic-like TPEE material without breaking. A toddler in a high chair at a restaurant is seen chewing on the durable temples of the glasses. A young boy then demonstrates the functional anti-drop strap attached to the glasses on the back of his head. (5) Close-up shots highlight the polarized UV400 lenses against a natural green field background with a house in the distance. Tiffany returns to the screen indoors, showing a white oval leather storage pouch clipped to her black quilted crossbody bag. The video concludes with a montage of various colorful sunglasses held in a hand and children of different ages wearing them in garden settings, ending with Tiffany posing with the boy.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female voice engaging in a playful dialogue with a male speaker. The man's voice is slightly muffled and processed due to the visual filter being used. An upbeat, medium-tempo electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat and bright synth textures plays in the background. A comical 'boing' SFX accompanies the visual face distortion. (2) As the competition begins, the female's vocal arousal increases with laughter and encouraging tones. The male's voice sounds strained and exaggerated as he tries to bend. A series of 'ding' and 'pop' SFX highlight successful or failed movements in the game. The BGM remains consistent, providing a driving rhythmic foundation with percussive drum hits that emphasize the playful tension. (3) The audio transitions into a more structured commercial narration by the female speaker. Her tone becomes professional yet warm and informative. The BGM shifts slightly in volume to prioritize the speech clarity. Sharp, crisp SFX such as 'swish' and 'click' are used during the transitions between the fast-cut outdoor product shots. (4) During the product durability demonstration, incidental sounds like the soft rustling of the plastic material and the toddler's muffled chewing noises are audible under the voiceover. The narrator's speech rate remains moderate and enunciated as she lists product benefits. High-frequency 'shimmer' SFX are added when the lenses are shown to emphasize protective features. (5) The final phase features a crescendo in the BGM energy as the narration reaches the call-to-action. The female voice maintains a high positive valence and authoritative tone. A final 'chime' SFX marks the completion of the presentation. The overall mix is clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio, typical of a professional social media advertisement.
